fatal_errors: The hypothesis concerns hierarchical HfNbTiVAl10, whereas the target study designed Nb15Mo2.5Ta40V40W2.5 within the Nb-Mo-Ta-V-W system.
It replaces the target composition-screening strategy based on rule-of-mixtures modulus, VEC, and density with an unreported imaging/APT/machine-learning intervention.
It proposes tensile and fracture testing rather than the demonstrated room-temperature quasi-static compression tests on as-cast specimens.
The claimed 20–30% accuracy gain and 50–60% turnaround-time reduction are unsupported by the cited evidence or any reported benchmark.
The proposed SRO and hierarchical-heterostructure mechanism is not the target mechanism of reduced VEC, lower Peierls–Nabarro barrier, enhanced dislocation slip, delayed cracking, and work hardening.

The falsification threshold does not directly compare performance against a predeclared established simulation baseline and could accept a model with errors too large to substantiate the claimed improvement.
explanation: There is only broad alignment with predicting mechanical properties of refractory multi-principal-element alloys. The target paper instead validated a simple composition-to-modulus estimator, screened 38,326 Nb-Mo-Ta-V-W compositions, and experimentally tested an as-cast low-VEC alloy in compression. Its central result was 35.7 ± 0.9% compressive fracture strain, 1115 ± 18 MPa yield strength, and 2550 ± 75 MPa compressive strength, compared with roughly 2% fracture strain and 1246 MPa yield strength for equimolar NbMoTaVW. None of these intervention details, conditions, mechanisms, baselines, or outcomes is reconstructed. The generated proposal has reasonable generic caveats about out-of-distribution specimens and APT sampling, and an independent holdout experiment could provide some discrimination. However, the cited papers only support isolated concepts such as refractory-alloy deformation, APT-based SRO measurement, and modulus measurement; they do not validate the proposed HfNbTiVAl10 model or its numerical gains. Consequently, the proposal is speculative rather than a supported alternative or reconstruction.
